tagline_withheld.text: RESIDENT FRIENDLY • HOA COMPLIANT • ENERGY SMART
tagline_withheld.reason: 'HOA COMPLIANT' is an unqualified compliance claim. HOA, landlord and building rules vary by association and by property, and nothing in the source material substantiates blanket compliance. Publishing it would also directly contradict the disclaimers this site carries, which tell the shopper to check their own HOA. 'RESIDENT FRIENDLY' and 'ENERGY SMART' are soft marketing and are lower risk.
tagline_withheld.action: The site uses the tagline-free primary lockup. Owner and legal to decide whether to reword (e.g. 'DESIGNED FOR HOA REVIEW'), qualify, or drop the middle claim before the full lockup is used anywhere public.
